method: Count footprint cells that are not within the shared 3-pixel Euclidean halo of the positive support of the hash-verified 13GEMSDOE lattice raster. Compare that finite cell capacity to the fixed H79-NHR emitted-dot budget; no candidate surface or hidden labels are used.
conclusion: For a 37,654-dot candidate on this grid, at most 6,514 distinct cells can be outside this registry raster's 3-pixel halo; therefore at least 82.70% of candidate dots must overlap, independently of candidate surface values. This budget cannot pass the literal 70% overlap gate against this raster.
scope_caveat: This bound is specific to the 37,654-dot budget and this indexed raster. It does not prove that every smaller-budget candidate is impossible. It is not a uniqueness certificate: the prior full-registry audit has six invalid/misaligned comparisons and remains incomplete.
